name: Andrew H. Heffernan

updates.occupation: School janitor (1900 census); court-house attaché (obituary, prior rounds)

residences.place: Plymouth Borough, Ward 3, Luzerne Co., Pa.
residences.note: Head, 53, b. Mar 1847 Ireland, married 31 years; school janitor; wife Mary mother of 11 children, 10 living

bioAdditions: The state death index for 1919 has "Hefferman, Andrew; 61616; Wilkes Barre; May 6" (S1), confirming the date Dwyer took from the certificate. In the 1900 census of Plymouth Borough, Ward 3 (S2) Andrew, 53, gave his birth as March 1847 in Ireland, immigration in 1863, and occupation school janitor; Mary, 49, born Nov 1850 in New York, had borne 11 children, 10 living. At home were Thomas (29, newspaper reporter), Norah (26, dressmaker), Annie (23, tailoress), Mary (21), Andrew (19), Josephine (16) and John (13). The "11 born, 10 living" count implies one child who died young, matching an unnamed "Daughter Heffernan" on FamilySearch.

conflicts.assessment: Census ages drift; the Killenaule baptism (1842) and Harvey's "seventy-six" at death in 1919 both point to 1842. Keep 1842.
Self-reported; fits arrival a few years before his 1868 marriage.

openQuestionsNew: 1900 census sheet 1B (continuation) should hold the rest of the household (Leo, George, and possibly widowed mother Catherine Boney, whom FamilySearch attaches to this ED).
